t: This is the home of the Constitution Unit, an independent, non-partisan research centre within the Department of Political Science at University College London. It studies constitutional change and its effects. Robert Hazell founded it in 1995, and he is Professor of Government and the Constitution at UCL. The unit specialises in parliament and parliamentary reform, elections and referendums, monarchy, church and state, and devolution. It also covers constitution-making, freedom of information legislation, the courts and legal system, and the relationship between the UK and EU.
